report_name: Stack Sports Breach Exposes Customer Payment Card and Bank Data

identities.name: Stack Sports
identities.description: A global sports technology and payments platform, operating as SPay Inc., that suffered a data breach exposing customer financial data, including payment card numbers, CVVs, and bank account numbers.

indicators.name: Potential Web Skimming Script Modification on Payment Pages
indicators.pattern:
title: Potential Web Skimming Script Modification on Payment Pages
id: 2b9a8b3c-1f7e-4d9a-8c1f-9a8b7c6d5e4f
status: experimental
description: |
  Detects the modification of JavaScript files located in directories commonly associated with payment or checkout processes.
  This could be an indicator of a web skimming (Magecart-style) attack where malicious code is injected to steal payment card information.
references:
  - https://www.claimdepot.com/data-breach/stack-sports-2026
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-28
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: high
logsource:
  category: file_event
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    TargetFilename|contains:
      - '/checkout'
      - '/payment'
      - '/cart'
      - '/onepage'
      - '/billing'
    TargetFilename|endswith: '.js'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects modification of JavaScript files on web servers, particularly those related to payment or checkout pages, which could indicate a web skimming (Magecart) attack as suggested by the hunting hints in the article.
